text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I won...! At the Sprinters Stakes...! I'm 
at the top of the sprint division...!! 
Ooooh!! I'm super happy, boss!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—And a few days later, Yaeno told me. She 
said she feels like I might be the one to 
change this 'Era of Oguri Cap'. But—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm not thinking about anything 
complicated. I only have one wish. I want 
to become Oguri-senpai's "ultimate 
rival"...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So I slapped Oguri-senpai with a challenge 
letter! And then she told me, "I was 
looking forward to competing with you!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The stage is set for the Mile CS!! The one 
standing at the apex of milers—is gonna be 
me, supers!
